release_notes: v1.2.5: Extends live capture to 10 minutes and gives a brief sound/haptic cue when the cap stops capture. Live TDT v2/v3 chunks now wait for a pause after at least five seconds of positively VAD-classified speech accumulated across short pauses; chunks remain ordered and the original PCM is preserved. Stop drains the tail and backlog before one final polishing step. Unified's online decoding path, completed-file and History recognition paths remain unchanged. Completed-file IPC input remains capped at 120 seconds; Voice Dictation's protected service uses a 15-minute total session deadline for capture and finalization. ARM64-only; updates remain manual. Recognition quality, latency and power use have not been validated on-device.
